trial_court: Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Banahatti (M.C.No.68/2022)
case_name: Gouramma Alias Gouri W/O Shivaraj ... vs Shivaraj S/O Sadashiv Chavare

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Gouramma Alias Gouri W/O Shivaraj, wife and student/household
parties.respondent_defendant: Shivaraj S/O Sadashiv Chavare, husband and agricultural/driver

facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife seeks to withdraw M.C.No.68/2022 pending on the file of Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Banahatti and transfer to Principal Judge, Family Court, Vijayapura due to uncordial relation between parties.

legal_principles.principle: The ends of justice should demand the transfer of the suit, appeal or other proceeding.
legal_principles.held: The cardinal principle for exercise of power under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure is that the ends of justice should demand the transfer of the suit, appeal or other proceeding.
cited_cases: N.C.V. Aishwarya VS. A.S.Saravana Karthik Sha, (2022) AIR SC 4318

legal_principles.principle: In matrimonial matters, the Courts have to take into consideration the economic soundness of both parties.
legal_principles.held: In matrimonial matters, wherever Courts are called upon to consider the plea of transfer, the Courts have to take into consideration the economic soundness of both the parties
cited_cases: N.C.V. Aishwarya VS. A.S.Saravana Karthik Sha, (2022) AIR SC 4318

outcome.final_order: Petitioner's prayer to withdraw M.C.No.68/2022 and transfer it to Principal Judge, Family Court, Vijayapura is allowed.

keywords: Latin maxim: Justice delayed is justice denied
